get.description: Returns datatable describing the number of visits for each day of the week.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The site ID. Cannot refer to multiple sites.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period type: day, week, year, range...

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The start date of the period. Cannot refer to multiple dates.
